proposals.expected_failure_mode: May still struggle with very sharp/asymmetric peaks (rise vs fall) and can be sensitive to peak timing across rolling splits when only I is observed.
proposals.rationale: Baseline anchor matching the previous best spec; SEIR can represent a sharper epidemic wave than SIR via an exposed stage while keeping parameterization parsimonious for a single-season, high-peaked series.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: If the true dynamics require an incubation/latent period, SIR may misplace peak timing or distort wave width; the 1-week delay may be weakly supported and can introduce identifiability/sensitivity issues.
proposals.rationale: Structurally different (drops E) while adding only a minimal 1-week reporting/admission lag; can yield a more abrupt rise/fall in the observed proxy without stacking multiple complexity increases, aligning with the note that hospital admissions may lag infections.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: Extra compartment can be weakly identifiable from a single observed series (I only), leading to parameter tradeoffs (I vs A) and instability across splits if the data do not support the added pathway.
proposals.rationale: Adds an asymptomatic (A) pathway to allow more flexible effective generation/clearance dynamics and potentially sharper or more asymmetric observed I trajectories without introducing an explicit hospitalization compartment that may be weakly identifiable in short series.
